items.summary: CVE-2026-122670 is a missing authorization vulnerability in the WP SYNTEX Polylang plugin affecting versions prior to 3.9.1. items.summary: A weakness in nexmoe VidBee up to versions 1.3.13 and 2.0.2 in the Local HTTP Service component allows remote attackers to cause information disclosure. items.summary: CivetWeb versions up to 1.16, when built with HTTP/2 support enabled, contain a use-after-free vulnerability in the HTTP/2 request handling function. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to manipulate HTTP/2 HEADERS frames to influence the request method or path used by access control rules or cause a server crash. (CVSS: 8.1)

items.title: Gitleaks through 8.30.1 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows local users to read scan…
items.summary: Gitleaks versions up to 8.30.1 have a vulnerability where scan report files are created with overly permissive default permissions. items.summary: Bar Assistant versions from 6.0.0-rc1 up to but not including 6.11.0 contain an authorization vulnerability in the CocktailController::copy function. The issue is fixed in version 6.11.0.

This flaw enables the attacker to gain kernel-mode read and write access, potentially leading to local privilege escalation and arbitrary kernel code execution.

items.title: ZDI-26-888: Quest NetVault Backup StnzCreateKey Numeric Truncation Error Denial-of-Service Vulnerability

items.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability exists in Quest NetVault Backup due to an integer underflow in the nvpmgr component. This flaw can be exploited remotely without authentication, causing affected systems to become unavailable. The vulnerability has been assigned CVE-2026-13270 and carries a high severity rating.

items.summary: A local vulnerability in Philips Hue Bridge Pro allows attackers with low-privileged code execution within a container to modify files on the device. The vulnerability is rated with a low severity score of 3.8 by ZDI. Exploitation requires prior access to execute code in a restricted environment, limiting the attack surface.

items.summary: A SQL injection vulnerability in Philips Hue Bridge Pro allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation requires authentication, but the authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The vulnerability is assigned CVE-2026-118632 with a high severity rating.

items.summary: A vulnerability in Philips Hue Bridge Pro allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication without needing credentials. This flaw enables unauthorized access to the device's functions. The vulnerability has a high severity rating of 8.8 assigned by the Zero Day Initiative.

Exploitation requires user interaction, such as visiting a malicious webpage or opening a malicious file. The vulnerability has a high severity rating assigned by ZDI and is tracked as CVE-2026-91131.

The vulnerability has been assigned CVE-2026-91131 and a CVSS rating of 5.4, indicating a medium severity level.
